description: Explore an output knob that has never been swept and costs nothing. On E038 (ls 0.4), multiply the head's fixed output scale (the airbench 1/9-style logit multiplier, rescaled for 100 classes) by 2x and change nothing else. The scale is a graph constant, so recapture all graphs in build. Run salt 0 and salt 1. Contingency: if the 2-salt mean falls by >=0.15 pp, run 0.5x next. Larger smoothing (ls 0.4) lowers the optimal logit magnitude, so the scale and ls interact.
